Huh? Oh, it's you. Didn't I tell ya?\nAsk the golem for shopping... *yawn*\n...What? Then, what am I here for, you asked?
I was wondering the same thing. Everything,\nincluding purchasing stock and settling balances,\nis automated. What am I here for?
Well, I can't find the answer even if I think much\nabout it. So, that's why I'm sleeping here.\nI don't care... I'm just slee... py... Zzz...
Oh, I've never seen you before around here.\nIt's your first time in this town? Oh, then\nwelcome to Einklang... You'll like this town.
Robots do all the onerous tasks.\nThough I'm the town mayor, I'm leaving most of my\nwork to the robots.
Oh, traveler. Have you got used to the life here?\nBecause the robots do all the onerous tasks,\nit's convenient, isn't it?
Hm? You don't really have the chance to interact\nwith people? Well, same here. I'm the town mayor,\nbut I spend most days without talking to anyone.

Oh, you're the traveler from the other day.\nDo you have a second?
Actually, one of the vital machine components used\nin the city has broken down. I've been struggling\nto find something to replace it...
I need a material that can withstand heat and be\nprocessed...I'm thinking of the Scorching Scale\nfrom the Salamanders in the Blazing Graben...
Can you help me get it?\nI know it won't be easy,\nbut I believe you can do it. Please...
Yes, I can!
No, I can't!
Oh, thank you!\nPlease be careful!
Hm, I know it's probably difficult, but...\nIs there really no way you could help me...?\nI see.
Come see me anytime if you change your mind.\nI'll always be waiting for you.
Ooh! You got it for me!! Yeah, this should be\nsturdy enough to replace the broken component!\nThanks...Here's your reward. Go on, take it!
Oh, it's you...\nRight, you're here!\nI think you can help me.
Please don't tell anyone. Actually, I've been\ngathering information about Demi Machinas too,\nyou know, those ominous creatures...
Especially those made from human remains.\nThey all wear something like a mask...\nI suspect that thing carries a dark secret.
So could you please collect some of those\nmask-like things for me so that I can study them?
Sure, I'll lend you a hand.
I don't feel like it.
Thank you!\nThis is strictly confidential, you know.\nPlease keep it between us...
They may be monsters, but human remains are used\nin their creation. I understand if you feel uneasy\nabout fighting them...
Sorry, please forget everything I just said.\nBut, if you change your mind later, please come\nsee me.
Thank you! If my research goes smoothly, I should\nbe able to devise a countermeasure against the\nLyark faction.
Alright, here's your reward.\nTake it!
Oh, it's you. I need help with something.\nDo you have a moment?
The Pax Technistans have succeeded in developing a\ndevice capable of analyzing the components that\nmake up the Demi Machinas sent by the Lyark.
Once we understand them, we should be able to\ndevise a way to drive those Demi Machinas away...
The device is ready, but we're still missing the\nmaterial to analyze the components. It's difficult\nbecause it can only be taken from a Demi Machina.
So, I need you to bring me something that has a\nlot of the components that make up a Demi Machina.
The bone of a medium-sized Demi Machina called\nDusk Machina would be the ideal...\nWhat do you say? Will you do it for me?
I'll do it.
No, I'm sorry!
Oh, thank you for agreeing to do it!\nAlright, please get a Dusk Machina bone for me.\nA big one, just one will do.
You'll be heading to a place where not only Dusk\nMachinas, but many other Demi Machinas also roam\nfreely, so be careful...
Hm, I know it's probably difficult, but...\nIs there no way I could convince you to\nreconsider...? I see.
Come see me anytime if you change your mind.\nI'll always be waiting for you.
Oh, I'm glad you returned safely! I was worried\nfor a second because you came back a bit early,\nbut look at that! You got the Dusk Machina bone!!
Thanks! This is a small reward for you.\nGo on, take it!
Alright, let's begin analyzing this bone with the\ndevice. It may take some time, so please wait here\nfor a while...
Thanks for the material the other day. The device\nhas completed its analysis and the components\nmaking up the Dusk Machina have been identified...
The analysis shows that it is created by combining\na human corpse with several types of beast and\nmonster components...
S-sorry...The corpse used as the base had been\nmodified to the point it was grotesquely deformed,\nbut I still knew whose body it was...
It-it was...I really didn't wanna believe it, but\nit was my...ngh...my son...\nMy son who went to Ultimea and never came back!!
All this time...I believed my son was still alive\nsomewhere...I wanted to believe that...ngh...\nBut in a sense, maybe it's better this way...
Although it's only a part of him, at least he's\nback...I can finally lay him to rest now.\nA funeral without a body is just heartbreaking...
Huh? O-oh, it's you...They say good things come to\nthose who wait...I've been waiting for someone who\ncould lend me a hand.
Lyark's weapons have become much more powerful\nrecently. I can no longer turn a blind eye to the\ndamage they're inflicting on our allies...
Rumor has it they're using a chemical called Flame\nGunpowder for their explosives. As we don't have\nthat chemical, we have no way to counter them...
With that in mind, could you please get me some\nsamples of Flame Gunpowder? I'd like to study its\npower so that we can find a way to fight back.
Leave it to me!
I'm scared.
You have my thanks. I must ask that you collect\nthe samples in total secrecy.\nWe can't let the enemy catch wind of our plans...
Indeed, you'll have to venture deep into enemy\nterritory to get the samples. I can't force you to\nrisk your life for someone you hardly know...
Sorry, please forget everything I just said.\nBut, if you change your mind later, please come\nsee me...
Oh! It's Flame Gunpowder...Thanks!\nThese samples should be enough for me to figure\nout a way to counter Lyark's weapons...
Thanks for your help! Here's your reward!\nPlease take it.

Because people in the town don't really welcome\noutsiders...But well, somehow things work out for\nme since you came...
Oh? Really? Should I just move to another place\nafter saving enough money?\nBut I like this place anyway...
Oh! It's you!! Thanks for coming!! I don't really\nhave a large selection of items but I'm sure you'll\nfind something you need. Enjoy your shopping.
Yumomo's General Store
Thanks! I'll be here, so please drop by again\nwhen you need something. Come to see me before\nI starve to death! It's a promise!
Yumomo's Storage
Good day. Nice weather, isn't it...?\nMe? I'm a blacksmith. Please ask me if you want\nto refine or upgrade weapons...
What? Well, this store is fully automated,\nso there's nothing I need to do.
Tremendous amount of information about weapons\nand refinement skills handed down over generations\nis all in the robot. It works well.
Again?! I've had it! ...Oops.\nH-Hello. The fully automatic robot ran out\nof power so...
Ran out of power?
Energy scarcity has become a serious problem\nas the town becomes increasingly mechanized.
The fuel for steam engines are hard to get because\nof monsters and Goddess Beads used in the old days\nare extremely rare now.
Holy gems serve as a substitute for them, but\nthey can only be created with the Resistle's\ntechnology.
So, you mean an enormous amount of power is needed\nbut there are not enough power resources?
Right. I guess this is happening not only here\nin Einklang but also in the whole residential\nareas of Technista.
Oh, therefore it doesn't mean it's good when\neverything 's made automatic. We must conserve and\nsave energy even if people call us stingy...
Wait a sec. The whole areas of Technista?\nYou mean Lyark as well?
I have no idea... But they're technologically more\nadvanced, so their situation may be more serious,\nor they might have a new powerful energy source...
What do you think?
You don't have any information about Lyark now, so\nit's impossible to tell...

Hmm, there's gotta be a way...\nOh!
I don't mean to be rude, but you came at just the\nright time.\nI need help. Would you hear me out?
You see, there's a golem working here.\nI've run out of the oil needed for its\nmaintenance.
Without the oil, it would rust...\nSupplies are hard to come by these days.\nI'd be grateful if you could get some for me...
I'll get it for you.
Sorry, I don't have time now.
Thank you!\nAnd of course, I'll prepare something for you in\nreturn...
U-uh~...\nI'm not going to force you, but...\nPlease help me when you have time.
Thank you!\nThis will prevent the golem from rusting.
Ah, oh?\nS-sorry to bother you.
The golem I'm using has been acting a little\nweird...When I checked it, I found some broken\nparts.
I could fix them myself if I had the necessary\nmaterials...\nWould you mind collecting them for me?
They say the materials can be found in a place\ncalled the Blazing Graben, but I'm afraid I can't\ngo all the way there myself...
I'll get them for you.
I can't help you now.
Thank you!\nThe golem's fate is in your hands. I'm counting on\nyou.
Oh...W-well, I'm sure you have your own things to\ndo...I would appreciate it if you could help me\nwhen you have time.
Thank you! Now I can fix the golem.\nHere, a small token of my gratitude.\nPlease accept it.
Oh, it's you.\nUm...do you have a moment right now? I have a\nsmall favor to ask...
Actually, the stock of materials for golem\nmaintenance is getting a bit low...
I'm not sure when the next supply will arrive, so\nI'd feel much better if I had some extra on\nhand...
How can you get the materials...? It seems you can\nfind plenty of them if you go to the Singolare\nRuins...
Huh...? Yes, I wanted to ask you to get some\nsupplies for me...\nWould you be willing to do that?
Yes, I can help.
No, I can't.
Really?! I'm glad to hear that...\nIt's not urgent, but the sooner you could gather\nthem, the better.
Oh, you can't?\nI was hoping you could help, but I understand.\nIf you change your mind later, please let me know.
Thank you!\nNow I can finally stop worrying about the stock.\nHere, for you!
U-um...sorry.\nI'd like you to help me with something...\nDo you have time now?
I've managed to secure the materials for golem\nmaintenance, but the repair tools are all rusted\nand no longer usable...
If I don't prepare the tools now, I'll just end\nup in trouble later. So, could you please collect\nsome usable tools for me?
Leave it to me.
I'm busy right now...
Thank you!\nAll right, here...I've written down what I need\nyou to collect. I'm counting on you.
...Oh, you're busy?\nI don't really have anyone else to ask...\nIf your schedule opens up, please let me know.
Thank you very much!\nI'm so glad you were here to help.
Oh, here's your reward. Is it all right?\nYes...well then, I hope you can help me again next\ntime.
Again?! This is getting really annoying!\n...Oh, hi. I'm sorry you had to see that...
The clock stops working several times a day.\nIt's driving me nuts...Huh?\nNo, it's not because it ran out of power...
Since this town is full of machines, strong\nmagnetic fields are generated everywhere and they\nmake clocks with metal hands stop...
There are public clocks everywhere in this town,\nbut still, not having one at home is inconvenient,\nright? I really don't know what to do...
...Huh? Oh, the hands of public clocks are\nspecial. They don't stop as they're made with a\nspecial mineral not affected by magnetic fields...
But they're expensive...I heard Lyark's mechanical\nmonsters are equipped with Unstoppable Clock Hands\ntoo, but I don't stand a chance against them...
...You're an adventurer, aren't you? I'll make\nsure you're properly rewarded. Could you please\nbring me some Unstoppable Clock Hands?
I'll bring them for you.
Maybe next time!
Thank you! Are you asking where the monsters are?\nSorry, I don't know the exact location, but...\nI think they work at some kind of Lyark factory.
I'd like you to collect around 20 clock hands...\nI'll make sure your reward is ready when you get\nback. I'm counting on you.
U-uh~...\nI'm not going to force you, but...\nPlease help me when you have time.
You're back already?! That was fast!\nLet me see... Yes, there are 20 Unstoppable Clock\nHands here. Thank you!
All right, here you go...Please take it!\nI might need your help again in the future, and\nI hope you'll help me again when the time comes.
Huff...There's gotta be something I can do...\nOh, hi...Huh? Yes, I was just thinking about\nsomething...
Actually, I've thought up an easy-to-make weapon\nfor fighting Demi Machinas. It fires explosive\nmetal balls that turn them into Swiss cheese.
It's simple. Just put explosives and metal balls\ninto a metal casing. If I use the self-destruct\nbutton and ball bearings from a Demi Machina,
it'll be cheap too! It seems good in every way,\nso I'd like to try making it. But, I can't get\nthe materials. I can't beat a Demi Machina...
Oh, right! May I ask you to collect the materials\nfor me? You seem very capable...
I don't have much to offer as a reward, but I'll\ndo my best to prepare what I can. Could you please\nhelp me?
Okay.
I can't.
Thank you! Then please collect some ball bearings\nand a self-destruct button for me. It's okay if\nthe button is broken. I'll fix it.
The ball bearings...Hm, 30 should be enough...\nYou need to defeat a Demi Machina to get them,\nso please be careful.
I'll have the reward ready by the time you get\nback. I'm counting on you.
Oh, really? I was hoping you could help, but...\nI understand. If you change your mind later,\nplease let me know.
Wow! Thank you!!\nNow I can try to make the weapon.
All right, here you go...No, you went through a\nlot, so please take it. If I need your help with\nsomething again, I'll let you know.
Okaaay, sorrry...it's fixed nowww~.\n...Oh, hi. I'm sorry you had to see that...
I've been swamped with repair requests lately...\nYeah, haven't slept for 3 days. Oh, it's fine.\nI've done a whole week before, haha...
But well...I guess I'm at peak exhaustion right\nnow...This is when an Energy Bottle usually perks\nme up, though...
But it can only be harvested from monsters in\nSykea Deep Valley...I'd really appreciate it if\nsomeone could go get it for me, though~...
Fine, I'll help you out.
No, it's too tiring.
You'll get it for me? Thank you~...\nYeah, Sykea Deep Valley...That's what I heard...\nPlease bring me around 30 bottles if possible...
I'll think of some kind of reward for you while\nyou're away~...\nI'm counting on you...
U-uh~...Yes, I understand...\nI'm not going to force you.\nMaybe next time...
I think...I've reached my limit...I'm gonna take a\nquick nap...Mm, please stop by again sometime~...\nGood night~...
Zzz...Huh? Eh-oh, you're back alreadyyy?\nThat was fast...Yeah~...\nThere are 30 Energy Bottles right here~...
Thank you...Oh, here...your reward...\nGo ahead, take it~...If something else comes up,\nI'll ask you again, okayyy~...
Huff...There's gotta be something I can do...\nOh, hi...Huh? Yes, I was just thinking about\nsomething...
Actually, I've got a lot of requests to repair\ngolems...That's fine, but the problem is, there\nare not enough spare parts to fix them...
Ordering from a parts maker is expensive and takes\ntime. I've been using parts from scrapped machines\nand golems, but I've run out of those too...
There's a place with plenty of parts, but...It's\nthe Lyark's Demi Machina Factory...If someone like\nme went there, I might never make it out alive...
Oh, right! May I ask you to collect the spare\nparts for me? You seem very capable...
I don't have much to offer as a reward, but I'll\ndo my best to prepare what I can. Could you please\nhelp me?
Okay.
Maybe next time.
Thank you! In that case, please collect some Huge\nScrews and Mysterious Luminaries... How many,\nyou ask? Well~, around 30 each should do.
You need to defeat the Demi Machinas and golems\nin the factory to get them, so please be careful.
I'll have the reward ready by the time you come\nback. I'm counting on you.
Oh, really? I was hoping you could help, but...\nI understand. If you change your mind later,\nplease let me know.
Wow! Thank you!!\nNow I can finish up what I need to repair.
All right, here you go...No, you went through a\nlot, so please take it. If I need your help with\nsomething again, I'll let you know.

I'll try.
I'm not good at inspecting stuff...

Hm, I see.\nIt'd be such a great help if you could do it,\nthough...Guess it's just bad timing, then.
There aren't many adventurers like you. So if you\nchange your mind, could you please come back here?\nI'll ask you once again then.
Thanks for your hard work. I knew I could count on\nyou.

Oh, it's you.\nDo you have a moment...?\nYou know the Site of Simcracker, don't you?
It's not a place you'd go for fun, but there are\nquite a few guiding jobs there.\nIt's a good place to earn money.
I'd like to give it a try.
Maybe next time.
Oh, nice! That's really reassuring.\nI knew you were the only one I could count on.
I'm officially handing the task over to you then.\nGet rid of the Muddy Gnomes at the Site of\nSimcracker.
I see. Well, I've been busy too recently, so maybe\nI should take a break from guiding jobs for a\nwhile...A little time off wouldn't hurt, I guess.
If you change your mind, let me know...\nBut not too soon, please.
What? It's done already?\nThat was way too fast... Huh? Wait, what?!\nWow, you really took them out!
I thought I could rest a little longer...\nOh well, lemme get back to making some money then.\nHere's your reward. Take it.
Uh~, now what...Oh, sorry! What's up?\nOh, me...? I wish I could say I'm fine, but\nI'm actually in a bit of trouble...
There's a place called the Peligro Landfill if you\nkeep going west. Lately, a really terrible smell\nhas been wafting over from there.
I had some scholars and technicians check it out.\nIt turns out the cause is a type of Demi Machina.\nApparently, there are so many of them there.
It's a plant-type Demi Machina that absorbs waste,\nferments it into mud, and releases it. If we do\nnothing, that place could end up buried in mud...
You're an adventurer, right? Could you go take out\nsome of them? It's getting pretty serious.\nI'll reward you generously!
Let me handle this.
Not now...
I knew you'd say so! I'm counting on you!\nOh, but there are other monsters too in the\nlandfill, so don't let your guard down.
...Well, I'm not gonna force you.\nBut, will you please come here when you think you\ncan do it?
Because for now, it seems you're the only one\nI can count on...
That was fast! You're back already?! Wasn't that a\nlittle too fast...? Huh? Wait?! No kidding...\nYou really took them out...Amazing! Good job!!
Alright, here's your reward. Take it!\nYou've been a great help. I hope you can help me\nagain next time.
Oh, it's you. Perfect timing.\nI really need your help with something related to\nour plan to re-inspect the ruins...
There's one important task that an ordinary\ninspector probably can't handle. Deep in the\nruins, there's a monster with an Evil Magic Sword.
Only someone of your caliber could handle this.\nI'd really appreciate it if you'd take the job...\nWhat do you say?

There aren't many adventurers like you. So if you\nchange your mind, could you please come back here?\nI'll ask you once again then.

Here's your reward. Come on, take it.\nOn behalf of the inspection team, thank you.\nI'll let you know if I need help again.

One or two are fine, but in large numbers, they go\nberserk and terrorize travelers and peddlers\npassing through the valley.
Because of that, I hardly get any guiding jobs now\nand my business is falling apart! It makes me mad,\nbut there's nothing I can really do about it...
You're an adventurer, right? Could you go take out\nsome of them? I know I'm asking a lot, so I'll\nmake sure to reward you generously!
I'll take them out!
I don't think that's possible...

Because for now, it seems you're the only one\nI can count on...

Have you heard about Lyark's plan to attack?\nThere have been rumors circulating around here...
I heard they're planning to deploy a massive army\nof golems to tear this town down.
It seems they're planning to send the golems\nthey're making at the Large Demi Machina Factory.\nI need to do something before that happens...
So before the golems in the factory come to attack\nus, could you go there and destroy them?\nOnly someone of your caliber could do it.
I'd really appreciate it if you could do it...\nWhat do you say?
I'll go destroy them!
I can't help you now.
Nice! Thank you! Sorry for asking you to do this\non such short notice. I'll make sure everyone in\ntown pitches in for your reward. Thanks again!

Excuse me? Sir?\nCan I ask you something?
Huh? If you wanna buy something, ask the golem...\n*yawn*
I'm asking cuz the golem won't say anything.\nThis is the first time we visited this town, so\nwe don't know how to shop. Could you tell us?
Whaaat? First time to visit here?\nThen, you can't shop here.\nJust go to another place...
